company.name: Vditory
company.shortDescription: “Vditory” empowers the blinds and the Visually impaired people, by providing the necessary tools to live independently.
company.description:
“Vditory” tries to make up for the vision disabilities through auditory technologies for the blinds and the Visually impaired people all around the world, by providing them with the necessary tools to live effortlessly and independently. It aids in removing the barrier to let them interact more with the society and live their daily lives as they please including doing their work and studies. 
Vditory enables them to explore the world around them in ways that weren't possible before. First, it reads any text displayed in front of the users and says it into their ears, enabling them to read books, magazines, or even menus in restaurants or any text they might run into in their day-to-day activities. Similarly, it helps them live independently by describing everything surrounding them, including any objects placed in front of them and even humans. When Vditory detects a human near the user, it will either recognize the person's name if they were on their database, or it will simply tell the user the person's gender, age and emotional expressions. Vditory can also recognize currencies and colors in a matter of seconds. Due to the fact that we value the user's safety more than anything, that is why Vditory will always track the user's location, which will only be accessible by the person who the user chooses as to be responsible for them in case of emergency. 
All of this is done by one simple click on a button, making the users' lives a lot simpler, more productive and fun!
